Gorham Bike & Ski Friday Morning Coffee Shop Road Ride

Portland, ME

Gorham Bike & Ski Friday Morning Coffee Shop Road Ride is a road group ride in Portland, ME. It meets Fridays, 8:00 am, first Friday in May through last Friday in November, starting at Gorham Bike & Ski, Portland. Pace: talking pace out, can get spirited on the way back.

About the Gorham Bike & Ski Friday Morning Coffee Shop Road Ride group ride

A Friday morning ride at talking pace up to Yarmouth for coffee and something to eat, then back to Portland. Road bikes only. Has been known to keep going through winter when the roads allow.
